entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options
entities.description: This IE is included when the UE wishes to transmit protocol data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the network. It requires that extended protocol configuration options are supported by both the UE and the network end-to-end for the PDN connection.

entities.name: Extended PCO supported by UE and network
entities.description: Condition that extended protocol configuration options are supported by both the UE and the network end-to-end for the PDN connection.

entities.name: Transmit protocol data to network
entities.description: UE transmits protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events to the network.

relations.description: Inclusion of the Extended protocol configuration options IE is guarded by the condition that extended PCO is supported by both UE and network.
Inclusion of the Extended protocol configuration options IE establishes that the UE wishes to transmit protocol data to the network.
